messages:
matt.healy: thinking out loud — we keep hitting spikey latencies and cold-kv misses when we migrate tenants from /v1 -> /v2. proposal: a "delegation warmup" shim that rewrites incoming v1 requests to v2 for a subset of traffic while pre-populating KV/prefix caches. want feedback on tradeoffs.

anita.k: +1 on the idea, especially for heavy prompt templates. curious about how we detect which tenants get the warmup. do we opt-in per-tenant or infer from traffic?

matt.healy: prefer tenant opt-out model: enable by default during migration windows, tenants can opt-out with header `X-Compat-Opt: out`. rollout phases controlled by percentage flag.

jordan: quick notes on implementation: shim would live in gateway layer, do header sniffing and rewrite payload + add `X-Compat-Warmup: <seed>` to requests forwarded to runtime. warmup path should call a `/warmup` async endpoint that loads KV/kv-cache and tokenization cache.

lia: what about correctness? vocab/tokenization drift between v1 and v2 might cause subtle output diffs. we need a QA harness that runs a small eval set after warmup and compares results before marking tenant fully migrated.

matt.healy: agreed — plan: 1) header detection, 2) soft-route 1% traffic through shim + warmup prefetch, 3) collect eval diffs on small prompt set, 4) bump rollout to 10/50/100. if diffs > threshold, auto-rollback.

jordan: config example for rollout flags: ```
compat_warmup:
  enabled: true
  rollout_pct: 1
  eval_prompts: /configs/migration/eval-small.json
  diffs_threshold: 0.02
```

lia: ops concern: memory - warmup will populate per-tenant KV and could increase GPU memory pressure. we should limit concurrent warmups per host and have a reclamation TTL. also add a cold-start penalty metric.

matt.healy: noted. suggested limits: max_concurrent_warmups=4 per host, ttl=15m, eviction LRU. add metrics `compat.warmup.started`, `compat.warmup.completed`, `compat.warmup.failed`, `compat.eval.diff_pct`.

anita.k: telemetry question — do we keep per-tenant diffs in plaintext? needs sanitization for PII. also mark these events for audit logs so enterprise customers can see migration status.

jordan: will wire diffs to anonymized eval pipeline (hash prompt ids) and store only aggregated stats for compliance. detailed diffs only available if tenant explicitly opts in.

deploy-bot: canary deployed: gateway/warmup-shim v0.1 -> staging (us-west-2) :rocket:

sre-bot: alerting rule proposal: `if compat.warmup.failed_rate > 0.05 for 5m then paging` and `if compat.eval.diff_pct > 0.05 for 10m then auto-rollout-hold`.

lia: one more: make sure fallback path exists — if warmup path errors, request should fallback to original v1 handler (no partial failures). keep end-to-end idempotency.

matt.healy: final checklist I propose: 
- add header detection + opt-out header
- implement gateway shim + `/warmup` async prefetch
- concurrency limits + TTLs
- eval harness + aggregated telemetry
- rollback/hold conditions wired into rollout service
- docs + tenant-visible audit events

anita.k: SGTM. I'll draft an RFC follow-up with diagrams and estimated perf cost.

jordan: I'll start a PR for gateway pieces and a small e2e test in staging.

lia: I'll work on SLO updates and alerting.

matt.healy: thanks all — pinging @anita.k for RFC, @jordan for PR, @lia for SLO. we'll reconvene after initial canary (target: next week). :thumbsup:
